paras: Application: Toyota GR86 (2022+), Subaru BRZ (2022+) Part Type: Billet aluminium fuel pump hanger – pumps not included Part Number: 20-1074

The Radium Fuel Pump Hanger replaces the factory in-tank fuel pump module on the 2022+ Toyota GR86 and Subaru BRZ and supports one or two aftermarket fuel pumps while retaining the OEM fuel level sender.
hl: Verified Pumps: Walbro F90000267 / F90000274 / F90000285, DeatschWerks DW440 / DW810, Fuelab 49614, Protec 11928
Single or Dual Pumps: Replaces the factory in-tank module and supports one or two aftermarket pumps
OEM Sender Retained: Factory fuel level sender reused
Collector Box: One-piece anodised aluminium box with 355 LPH one-way fill valve
Redesigned Venturi: Jet pump siphon with reduced return restriction
Single Merged Outlet: Pumps merge to one 8AN ORB pump-out port
